pages.lesson:
LESSON: SARUFI 11.4.3 UKUBWA NA UDOGO WA NOMINO

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi
2. kukanusha viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kukanusha viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi
   In simple words: practise until you can kukanusha viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino.
4. Show that you can: kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 11.4.3 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi
2. kukanusha viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
